SELECT r.id AS refund_id, r.order_id, o.order_number, r.amount, r.refunded_at FROM refunds AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = r.order_id WHERE r.reason = 'late_delivery' ORDER BY r.refunded_at, r.id

SELECT r.id AS refund_id, r.order_id, o.order_number, r.amount, r.refunded_at, r.reason FROM refunds AS r JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = r.order_id WHERE r.reason = 'late_delivery' ORDER BY r.refunded_at, r.id;
SELECT id AS region_key, name AS region_label FROM regions;
SELECT r.id AS region_key, r.name AS region_label FROM regions AS r ORDER BY r.id
SELECT o.id, o.order_number FROM orders AS o WHERE o.sales_rep_id = 1 ORDER BY o.id
SELECT id, order_number, customer_id, ordered_at, status, currency, subtotal, discount_amount, total_amount, sales_rep_id FROM orders WHERE sales_rep_id = 1 ORDER BY ordered_at, id;

SELECT id, order_number, discount_amount, total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE discount_amount > 0
  AND total_amount > 150;
SELECT o.order_number, o.discount_amount, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.discount_amount > 0 AND o.total_amount > 150 ORDER BY o.total_amount DESC
SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers AS c ORDER BY c.id LIMIT 8
SELECT id, name FROM customers ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 8;
SELECT currency, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS unique_order_keys FROM orders GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency
SELECT o.currency, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS unique_order_keys FROM orders AS o GROUP BY o.currency ORDER BY o.currency
SELECT o.order_number, o.status, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' OR o.total_amount < 40 ORDER BY o.order_number

SELECT o.id, o.order_number, o.customer_id, o.sales_rep_id, o.ordered_at, o.status, o.currency, o.subtotal, o.discount_amount, o.total_amount FROM orders AS o WHERE LOWER(o.status) = 'cancelled' OR o.total_amount < 40 ORDER BY o.ordered_at, o.id;

SELECT sr.id, sr.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count
FROM sales_representatives AS sr
LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id
GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name
ORDER BY order_count DESC, sr.name
LIMIT 6;
SELECT sr.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM sales_representatives AS sr JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 6
SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS distinct_product_count FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS distinct_product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
SELECT id AS customer_id, name AS customer_name, sales_rep_id AS assigned_representative_key FROM customers ORDER BY id;
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name AS customer_name, c.sales_rep_id AS assigned_representative_key FROM customers AS c ORDER BY c.id
SELECT o.order_number FROM orders AS o WHERE o.currency = 'JPY' ORDER BY o.order_number

SELECT id, order_number, currency, ordered_at, total_amount
FROM orders
WHERE currency = 'JPY'
ORDER BY ordered_at, id;

SELECT order_number AS order_reference, discount_amount > 0 AS has_positive_discount
FROM orders;
SELECT o.order_number AS order_reference, o.discount_amount > 0 AS discount_is_positive FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.order_number
SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.customer_id
SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM orders;

SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.amount, p.paid_at, p.status, LEAD(p.paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_id ORDER BY p.paid_at, p.id) AS next_payment_at FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.order_id, p.paid_at, p.id;

SELECT p.id, p.order_id, p.amount, p.status, p.paid_at, LEAD(p.paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY p.order_id ORDER BY p.paid_at, p.id) AS next_payment_at FROM payments AS p ORDER BY p.order_id, p.paid_at, p.id

SELECT sr.name AS representative, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.subtotal), 0) AS subtotal_value FROM sales_representatives AS sr LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY sr.name

SELECT sr.id AS representative_id, sr.name AS representative_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.subtotal), 0) AS subtotal_value FROM sales_representatives AS sr LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name ORDER BY sr.name
SELECT reason AS return_reason, COUNT(*) AS row_total FROM refunds GROUP BY reason ORDER BY row_total DESC, return_reason
SELECT r.reason, COUNT(*) AS row_total FROM refunds AS r GROUP BY r.reason ORDER BY r.reason
SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS product_count FROM products AS p GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY p.category
SELECT category, COUNT(id) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category;
SELECT order_number AS order_reference, status AS lifecycle_text FROM orders;
SELECT order_number AS order_reference, status AS lifecycle_text FROM orders
SELECT DISTINCT o.status AS lifecycle_state FROM orders AS o ORDER BY o.status
SELECT DISTINCT status FROM orders ORDER BY status NULLS LAST;

WITH summary AS (SELECT sr.id AS representative_id, sr.name AS representative_name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM sales_representatives sr LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name) SELECT representative_id, representative_name, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_rank FROM summary ORDER BY order_rank, representative_name;

WITH representative_summary AS (SELECT sr.id, sr.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM sales_representatives AS sr LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.sales_rep_id = sr.id GROUP BY sr.id, sr.name) SELECT name, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS order_count_rank FROM representative_summary ORDER BY order_count_rank, name
